claim:
PR title: fix(ops): the kernel's admin pages use tailnet port 8446, clear of Grafana (8444) and the gate (8445)

3a (#171) put the kernel's sign-in and approval pages behind `tailscale serve --https=8444`, which the monitoring docs (and the live host) already use for Grafana. `ops/setup.sh`, `docs/design/access.md` and `docs/operations/migrate-host.md` now use 8445 for the admin listener.
